items.title: Alerting and Detection Strategies (ADS) Framework | Palantir
items.description: A blueprint for creating and documenting effective detection content.

items.title: Synthetic Adversarial Log Objects (SALO) | Splunk
items.description: Synthetic Adversarial Log Objects (SALO) is a framework for the generation of log events without the need for infrastructure or actions to initiate the event that causes a log event.

items.title: ZettelForge
items.description: Agentic memory system that treats Sigma and YARA rules as first-class memory entities, with an LLM rule explainer, STIX 2.1 knowledge graph of CTI entities, and offline-first RAG to connect rules to the actors and techniques they detect. Python, MIT.

items.title: ThreatMapper | Andrey Pautov
items.description: CTI-to-detection workbench for mapping threat reports to ATT&CK, comparing TTP overlap with groups and campaigns, identifying detection gaps, and exporting analyst-ready outputs.

items.title: Sigma Rules
items.description: Sigma's repository of turnkey detection content. Content can be converted for use with most SIEMs.

items.title: Elastic Detection Rules
items.description: Elastic's detection rules written natively for the Elastic SIEM. Can easily be converted for use by other SIEMs using Uncoder.

items.title: KQL Advanced Hunting Queries & Analytics Rules
items.description: A list of endpoint detections and hunting queries for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Defender For Identity, and Defender For Cloud Apps.

items.title: Splunk Security Content
items.description: Splunk's open-source and frequently updated detection content that can be tweaked for use in other tools.

items.title: Elastic Endpoint Behavioral Rules
items.description: Elastic's endpoint behavioral (prevention) rules written in EQL, natively for the Elastic endpoint agent.

items.title: Elastic Yara Signatures
items.description: Elastic's YARA signatures, which run on the Elastic endpoint agent.

items.title: Elastic Endpoint Ransomware Artifact
items.description: Elastic's ranswomware artifact, which runs on the Elastic endpoint agent.

items.title: Chronicle (GCP) Detection Rules
items.description: Chronicle's detection rules written natively for the the Chronicle Platform.

items.title: Panther Labs Detection Rules
items.description: Panther Lab's native detection rules.

items.title: Center for Threat Informed Defense Security Stack Mappings
items.description: Describes cloud computing platform's (Azure, AWS) built-in detection capabilities and their mapings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

items.title: Agent Threat Rules (ATR)
items.description: An open MIT detection-rule standard for AI-agent and MCP attacks (prompt injection, tool poisoning, context exfiltration), like Sigma or YARA for the agent layer, with OWASP LLM/Agentic and MITRE ATLAS mappings on each rule.

items.title: Google Cloud Security Analytics
items.description: This repository serves as a community-driven list of sample security analytics for auditing cloud usage and for detecting threats to your data & workloads in Google Cloud.

items.title: RSigma | Timescale
items.description: A complete Sigma detection engineering toolkit with parser, evaluation engine, rule conversion, streaming runtime, linter, CLI, MCP, and LSP.

items.title: Anvilogic Detection Armory
items.description: Anvilogic's opensource and publicly available detection content.

items.title: Detection Engineering with Splunk
items.description: A GitHub repo dedicated to sharing detection analytics in SPL.

items.title: Exabeam Content Library
items.description: Exabeam's out of the box detection content compatible with the Exabeam Common Information Model.

items.title: Sigma2KQL
items.description: A repository of all SIGMA rules converted to KQL that runs on a weekly schedule to update the repository and align with the up to date version of the SIGMA rules repository.

items.title: TerraSigma
items.description: A repository of all SIGMA rules converted to Microsoft Sentinel Terraform Scheduled analytic resources. The repository runs on a weekly schedule to update the repository and align with the up to date version of the SIGMA rules repository. Proper entity mapping is completed for the rules to ensure the repo is plug-and-play.

items.title: Elastalert | Yelp
items.description: ElastAlert is a simple framework for alerting on anomalies, spikes, or other patterns of interest from data in Elasticsearch.

items.title: Loghub
items.description: Opensource and freely available security data sources for research and testing.

items.title: Linux auditd Detection Ruleset
items.description: Linux auditd ruleset that produces telemetry required for threat detection use cases.

items.title: Matano
items.description: Open source cloud-native security lake platform (SIEM alternative) for threat hunting, Python detections-as-code, and incident response on AWS 🦀.

items.title: Rustinel | Karib0u
items.description: Open-source endpoint detection engine for Windows and Linux that collects ETW/eBPF telemetry and evaluates Sigma, YARA, and IOC detections.

items.title: SOCTalk
items.description: Open source, LLM driven SOC automation platform for MSPs and MSSPs built on Wazuh. Triages, investigates, and escalates alerts through a two tier AI pipeline with human in the loop review, multi tenant isolation, and a no code triage policy editor backed by deterministic execution. Apache 2.0.

items.title: Exabeam Common Information Model
items.description: Exabeam's proprietary model used as a framework for normalizing security data.

items.title: Awesome Kubernetes (K8s) Threat Detection
items.description: Another Awesome List dedicated to Kubernetes (K8s) threat detection.

items.title: Detection and Response Pipeline
items.description: A list of tools for each component of a detection and response pipeline which includes real-world examples.

items.title: Splunk ES Correlation Searches Best Practices | OpsTune
items.description: A highly detailed guide to producing high quality detection content in the Splunk Enterprise Security app.
